purpose: Reuse the bounded context-sample method without importing machine paths, provider calls or game control into the repository.

suggested_inputs.narration_intake: Caller-supplied exact cue text/fingerprint, existing audio path/SHA/duration, original request identity
suggested_inputs.source_selection: Caller-supplied raw path/SHA, actual readable PTS limits, disjoint chosen intervals, terminal RED/unknown status and evidence role
suggested_inputs.attempt_directory: Fresh external output directory; refusal on existing media/artifacts
suggested_inputs.storage_admission: Current machine_id/time, actual package bytes, parent reservation and bounded additional peak
suggested_inputs.toolchain_probe: Fresh official Release + exact installed wheel SHA/interpreter/CLI observations

suggested_outputs: raw SHA/actual PTS to encoded cue/claim/source map
full AV decode and final PTS audit
forbidden_implicit_actions: Read fixed machine paths as defaults
Treat raw context as a clean business demonstration
Loop, slow or freeze footage to meet duration
retained_lesson: Pass pathlib.Path to preserve_artifact. Preserve failed attempts; retry into a fresh attempt rather than overwrite.
